dedupe_keys.name: interscsimulator large scale agent based smart city and traffic simulator interscity university of sao paulo

description: InterSCSimulator is an open-source, extensible simulator for smart city scenarios, written in Erlang on the actor model so that each agent, such as a car, hospital or gas pipeline, is an actor, and able to simulate millions of agents on a real city map. The first version is a large-scale traffic simulator: it builds a road digraph from OpenStreetMap, takes trips from random generation or an origin-destination matrix, simulates vehicles and writes event logs for map and chart visualisation. The InterSCity national institute at the University of São Paulo developed it, with publications from 2016 to 2019 on São Paulo mobility carbon footprint, bus models and autonomous vehicle platoon lanes. Coverage: demonstrated on São Paulo and New York City data. Format and access: source code on GitHub, built on EDF's Sim-Diasca engine and runnable with Docker. Licence: no licence file was found in the repository; free. Caveats: domains other than traffic are planned, not built, and activity has slowed. It supports agent-based and network flow studies of city systems. Related catalogue records are SUMO and MATSim.
